title: QSMP: finding representative time series subsequences through Quick Shift+Matrix Profile
abstract: arXiv:2608.15492v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Finding representative waveforms in long time series has scientific and practical value in many domains, as it enables summarization and visualization of large time series datasets, and downstream tasks like classification and forecasting. We present here QSMP, a method to find representative waveforms in long time series through a density-guided clustering of time series subsequences. Our method makes a novel connection between Quick Shift, a mode-seeking algorithm, and the Matrix Profile, a time series similarity-search data structure, to adapt Quick Shift to the clustering of subsequences in long time series, with a space complexity that is superior to the state-of-the-art method. Our experiments on synthetic and real datasets show that QSMP can be a valuable tool to summarize and visualize long time series by finding representative waveforms.

translated_title: QSMP：通过Quick Shift+Matrix Profile寻找代表性时间序列子序列
translated_abstract: 摘要：在长时间序列中寻找代表性波形在许多领域具有科学和实际价值，因为它能够实现大型时间序列数据集的摘要和可视化，以及支持分类和预测等下游任务。我们在此提出QSMP，一种通过密度引导的时间序列子序列聚类来寻找长时间序列中代表性波形的方法。我们的方法在Quick Shift（一种模式寻找算法）和Matrix Profile（一种时间序列相似性搜索数据结构）之间建立了新颖的联系，将Quick Shift适应于长时间序列中子序列的聚类，其空间复杂度优于现有最先进方法。我们在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，QSMP可以通过寻找代表性波形成为摘要和可视化长时间序列的有价值工具。
tldr: QSMP通过结合Quick Shift和Matrix Profile，提出了一种密度引导的子序列聚类方法，以高效寻找长时间序列中的代表性波形，且空间复杂度优于现有方法。
en_tdlr: QSMP introduces a density-guided subsequence clustering method by linking Quick Shift and Matrix Profile, efficiently finding representative waveforms in long time series with superior space complexity.
